name: orchestrate
description: Runs a request through the ultracode pipeline: research, spec, plan, per-phase implementation and review, then tests and docs if asked. Invoke only when the user types `/ultracode:orchestrate` or clearly asks for the ultracode pipeline. It never self-activates, never activates at session start, and subagents never load it.

config.argument_hint: [--yolo] [optional: the request to orchestrate, or leave blank to route the current conversation]
